reading_guidance.lead_line: Purpose of this revision stage: strengthen retrieval without opening a new first-pass chapter first. Attempt closed-book retrieval; only then reopen the exact failed locus.
focus_questions: Can you retrieve each return target in one short phrase?
What one rework will you schedule?
What claim must you refuse (spine / Isolated Golden Day / until-exam)?
misconception_watch: Watch for turning revision into a passive re-read.
Watch for claiming first-pass spine PASS.
Watch for Isolated Golden Day / until-exam trust claims.
reading_guidance.open_point: No new CMP open required to begin. Targeted re-open only after failed retrieval on the failed LO block.
reading_guidance.stop_condition: After revision checks and Reflection — do not begin out-of-scope first-pass LOs
reading_guidance.annotation_task: Before checks: sketch return-target chain from memory
reading_guidance.attempt_before_reveal: Attempt each check before any targeted CMP reopen
reading_guidance.exit_line: Begin closed-book retrieval. Reopen CMP only at a failed locus. After checks, complete Reflection.
reading_guidance.return_cue: Revision reading stage is complete when checks are attempted and any failed locus has a targeted reopen plan.

pause_points.cue: Pause — mark the weakest link before checks.

reading_guidance.reentry_line: Stay closed-book unless a check failed. Continue retrieval.
